sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, title, status, desk, published_at FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT id, status, body FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT id, article, kind, text, created_at FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'spike';
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT status, count() AS n, count(->covers) AS has_topic FROM article GROUP BY status; SELECT article.status AS st, count() FROM passage GROUP BY st;
SELECT id, status, (SELECT count() FROM passage WHERE parent = $parent.id)[0].count AS n_passages FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'] PARALLEL;
SELECT parent, count() FROM passage WHERE parent IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7] GROUP BY parent;
